text:
Elliot: Quick weekly from me 3 priorities + one ask. Please skim and ACK.
Priya: High-level: Private GA target remains 2026-05-12. Workstreams: compliance docs, sales enablement, and GA pricing. Need final legal sign-off by 2026-04-20.
Jonah: Ops/Reliability snapshot: rolling median latency 45ms, p95 280ms (up 12ms week-over-week on eu-west during peak), error rate 0.12% (down from 0.2%). Were on track for 99.95% target but need to reduce p95.
Ava: Capacity note: dedicated utilization at 72% overall; eu-west spike caused autoscaler to dip under target for 2h on Tuesday. We rolled hotfix to batcher and restored headroom. Change ticket RDW-4456.
Priya: User & revenue telemetry: monthly active API keys +28% MoM, embeddings volume +40% MoM. Forecast: expect 18-22% token growth next quarter given current cadence.
Elliot: Two leadership asks: 1) Reduce p95 by 50ms before next exec update (focus: batching config + kernel selection). 2) Confirm GA pricing ranges and margin floor to Finance by Friday.
Jonah: Action plan for p95:
```
- tweak batching window: -10ms
- enable adaptive KV caching for long-prefix workloads
- deploy model-specific kernel fallback for long sequences
- monitor p95 via /consumers/latency-dashboard (alert on +30ms)
```
Ava: Canary plan for GA ramp: staged 10/50/200 customers with 24/48/72h checks. Will reserve two extra pools per region for first 72h. announce-bot will post schedule.
announce-bot: [Scheduled] GA canary window: 2026-05-12T00:00Z  2026-05-15T00:00Z. Trigger: rollout/ga-canary/private-ga-2026-05
Lilli: People ops FYI: no immediate headcount shifts. Hiring focus stays on infra, SRE, and account support for April-May. Slack channel #hiring-infra for reqs.
Priya: Risk summary (one-liner bullets in the rollout doc please):
- legal sign-off delay (impact: GA hold)
- p95 regression during eu-west peak (impact: SLA risk)
- pricing leakage on dedicated (impact: margin compression)
Please add any other tactical risks to the doc by EOD Thursday.
Elliot: Also: quick incident recap for leadership — Tuesday cache eviction bug caused 8% error spike for 2h; root cause: race in eviction, fix: mutex + graceful fallback. Postmortem draft: https://intra.redwood/incidents/2026-04-07-eviction-bug (please review).
Jonah: Will post mitigation PR shortly and include performance regression tests in CI. Command to run local repro: `rdw test --case eviction-race --region eu-west`
Ava: Ops will own rollback gating and canary thresholds. I'll update the runbook and link it in the rollout doc.
Elliot: End ask: managers, one-line status & blockers (max 3 bullets) in the GA rollout doc by Friday COB. We'll review on Monday leadership sync. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
